## Project templates

| Template | Purpose | Runner | Starter deployment | Recommended artifact output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `minimal` | Create the smallest normalized accepted project authority. | `none` | `false` | `none` |
| `command` | Create a tested pure command with one exact built-in standard dependency. | `command` | `false` | `none` |
| `http` | Create an editable tested HTTP application and loopback starter deployment. | `http` | `true` | `generated/application.lkja` |
| `nostr-relay-info` | Create a tested NIP-11 relay-information proxy with one deployment-bound endpoint. | `http` | `true` | `generated/application.lkja` |
